title: EBI-Metagenomics/wdp pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet used by the wdp pipeline (Slice 1: gTranslate -> CheckM2 -> gemsparcl)

prefix.errorMessage: Prefix must be a versioned GCA/GCF accession (e.g. GCA_000006625.1) -- must match the basename of the assembly file exactly (before .fa/.fna/.fasta/.fasta.gz), since downstream tools (CheckM2, gTranslate, GUNC) derive each genome's ID from its assembly filename with only that suffix stripped

assembly.errorMessage: Assembly file must exist and have extension .fasta.gz -- must be named exactly '<prefix>.fasta.gz'

taxid.errorMessage: taxid must be a valid NCBI taxid (positive integer)

known_ttable.description: Optional per-genome codon table override (e.g. a hand-curated test row for a known table-4 genome). Leave empty to fall through to gTranslate.
